PROMPT = r"""
Build a full, production-ready, browser-based Cloud IDE platform with an integrated autonomous coding agent and a Nix-based reproducible environment system. Output a complete repository as code: first print the full file tree, then print every file in full, unabridged, production-ready content. Do not include explanations, summaries, TODOs, mock data, placeholders, simulated behavior, or fake outputs. All behavior must be real and executable.

Hard constraints:
- Backend must be implemented in exactly one Python file named: main.py
- Frontend must be implemented in exactly one HTML file named: index.html
  - index.html must include all UI routes/pages (single-page app) and contain all CSS/JS inline or embedded; no additional frontend files.
- Other non-frontend, non-backend files are allowed (e.g., flake.nix, project config, README, scripts), but the backend logic must remain entirely inside main.py and the entire UI must remain entirely inside index.html.
- Do not mention or reference any existing product or company name anywhere in code, comments, documentation, or UI text.

System requirements and capabilities to implement end-to-end:
1) Identity & Access (single-user mode, but secure)
   - Implement a secure single-user authentication mechanism suitable for self-hosting:
     - Password-based login with strong hashing (argon2 or bcrypt).
     - Session management using signed, HTTP-only cookies with CSRF protection.
     - Optional API token authentication for automation endpoints.
   - Provide an initial admin bootstrap flow on first run (create password if none exists).
   - Implement authorization checks on every API/WS endpoint.

2) Core concept: Project (workspace) with reproducible Nix environment
   - A project is a directory on disk under a configurable root (WORKSPACES_ROOT).
   - Each project contains:
     - A Nix environment definition using flake.nix (preferred) or env.nix fallback.
     - A project configuration file (project.toml) defining:
       - default run command
       - named workflows (dev/test/build/deploy)
       - exposed ports and health checks
       - language/tooling hints (optional)
   - Backend must:
     - Create new project with a minimal flake.nix and project.toml.
     - Import an existing project from a local path or from a Git URL.
     - Support git initialization and git operations (status, commit, log, diff) for checkpointing.

3) IDE Frontend (single index.html SPA)
   Implement a complete browser IDE UI that includes:
   - File explorer tree with create/rename/delete files and folders.
   - Editor with tabs, syntax highlighting, search-in-file, and project-wide search.
     - Use a production-grade in-browser editor loaded via CDN (permitted), with offline fallback not required.
   - Integrated terminal emulator using a production-grade terminal library loaded via CDN (permitted).
   - Output/log panels for workflow runs.
   - A workflow panel to run named workflows and view status.
   - A checkpoints panel: create, list, diff (at least via git), and rollback.
   - A secrets panel: set/delete secrets keys; never display secret values after set.
   - A deployments panel: create deployments and view status/URL.
   - An agent panel: chat UI + live activity stream showing tool calls, runs, diffs, and checkpoints.

4) Backend API (FastAPI recommended) in a single file main.py
   Implement a secure API with OpenAPI schema and strict validation:
   - Project management:
     - POST /api/projects            create project
     - GET  /api/projects            list projects
     - GET  /api/projects/{id}       get project metadata
     - DELETE /api/projects/{id}     delete project (safe delete with confirmation token)
     - POST /api/projects/import/git import from git URL (clone)
     - POST /api/projects/import/path import from local path (copy)
   - File operations (must prevent path traversal):
     - GET  /api/projects/{id}/tree
     - GET  /api/projects/{id}/file?path=...
     - PUT  /api/projects/{id}/file?path=... (create/update)
     - DELETE /api/projects/{id}/file?path=...
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/mkdir?path=...
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/rename (old_path, new_path)
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/search (query, include_globs, exclude_globs)
   - Nix environment operations:
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/nix/eval
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/nix/develop/run (command list, cwd, env)
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/nix/build (attr/target)
     - All Nix invocations must be sandboxed and resource-limited.
   - Workflow execution:
     - GET  /api/projects/{id}/workflows
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/workflows/run (name, args)
     - GET  /api/runs/{run_id}
     - Streaming logs must be supported over WebSocket and also as Server-Sent Events (SSE) fallback.
   - Terminal:
     - WebSocket /ws/terminal/{project_id}
       - Provide a fully interactive PTY-backed shell session inside the project’s Nix dev environment.
       - Support resize, stdin, stdout/stderr streaming, and clean termination.
   - Checkpoints and rollback (code + dev database snapshots):
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/checkpoints (label)
       - Create a checkpoint that includes:
         - Git commit of the workspace (auto-init git if not present).
         - Snapshot of development database state (see DB section).
         - Metadata stored in a durable checkpoint index.
     - GET  /api/projects/{id}/checkpoints
     - POST /api/projects/{id}/rollback (checkpoint_id)
       - Restore code to the checkpoint (git reset/checkout) and restore dev database snapshot.
     - Provide diff endpoints:
       - GET /api/projects/{id}/diff?from=...&to=...
   - Secrets management:
     - Secrets must be stored encrypted at rest using a master key provided via environment variable (MASTER_KEY).
     - Implement:
       - GET  /api/projects/{id}/secrets (list keys only)
       - PUT  /api/projects/{id}/secrets/{key} (set value; never return it)
       - DELETE /api/projects/{id}/secrets/{key}
     - During workflow runs and terminal sessions, inject secrets as environment variables securely without logging their values.
   - Deployments:
     - Provide two deployment types:
       A) Static deployment: build command + output directory served via backend on a stable URL.
       B) Service deployment: run a long-lived process (from deploy workflow) with health checks and a reverse proxy route.
     - Implement:
       - POST /api/projects/{id}/deployments (type, config)
       - GET  /api/projects/{id}/deployments
       - GET  /api/deployments/{deployment_id}
       - POST /api/deployments/{deployment_id}/stop
     - Ensure deployments run in an isolated environment with resource limits and do not expose secrets by default unless explicitly allowed.

5) Database model and dev/prod split (safety by isolation)
   - Use PostgreSQL for managed-like behavior but allow local self-hosting.
   - Enforce two logical databases (or schemas) per project:
     - Development database: used by workflows, terminal, and agent actions.
     - Production database: used only by deployments.

        process = subprocess.Popen(
            ["nix", "develop", "--command", "bash"],
            stdin=slave,
            stdout=slave,
            stderr=slave,
            cwd=project_path,
            preexec_fn=os.setsid
        )
        
        os.close(slave)
        
        async def read_output():
            loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
            while True:
                try:
                    output = await loop.run_in_executor(None, os.read, master, 1024)
                    if not output:
                        break
                    if websocket.client_state == WebSocketState.CONNECTED:
                        await websocket.send_bytes(output)
                except:
                    break
        
        read_task = asyncio.create_task(read_output())
        
        while True:
            data = await websocket.receive()
            if "bytes" in data:
                os.write(master, data["bytes"])
            elif "text" in data:
                os.write(master, data["text"].encode())
    
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        try:
            process.kill()
            os.close(master)
        except:

<script>
let currentProject = null;
let currentFile = null;
let editor = null;
let terminal = null;
let terminalSocket = null;
let agentSessionId = null;
let openTabs = {};

async function login() {
const username = document.getElementById('username').value;
const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
method: 'POST',
headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({username, password})
});
if (response.ok) {
const data = await response.json();
localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
document.getElementById('loginContainer').style.display = 'none';
document.getElementById('ideContainer').style.display = 'flex';
initIDE();
} else {
alert('Login failed');
}
}

async function logout() {
await fetch('/api/auth/logout', {method: 'POST', headers: getAuthHeaders()});
localStorage.removeItem('token');
location.reload();
}

function getAuthHeaders() {
return {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('token')};
}

async function initIDE() {
await loadProjects();
initMonaco();
initTerminal();
}

function initMonaco() {
require.config({paths: {'vs': ''}});
require(['vs/editor/editor.main'], function() {
editor = monaco.editor.create(document.getElementById('editorPane'), {
value: '',
language: 'javascript',
theme: 'vs-dark',
automaticLayout: true
});
});
}

function initTerminal() {
terminal = new Terminal({
cursorBlink: true,
fontSize: 14,
theme: {
background: '#1e1e1e',
foreground: '#d4d4d4'
}
});
const fitAddon = new FitAddon.FitAddon();
terminal.loadAddon(fitAddon);
terminal.open(document.getElementById('terminalPanel'));
fitAddon.fit();
}

async function loadProjects() {
const response = await fetch('/api/projects', {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const projects = await response.json();
const list = document.getElementById('projectList');
list.innerHTML = '';
projects.forEach(project => {
const item = document.createElement('div');
item.className = 'project-item';
item.textContent = project.name;
item.onclick = () => selectProject(project.id);
list.appendChild(item);
});
}

async function selectProject(projectId) {
currentProject = projectId;
await loadFileTree();
await loadWorkflows();
await loadCheckpoints();
await loadSecrets();
await loadDeployments();
connectTerminal();
await createAgentSession();
}

async function loadFileTree() {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/tree`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const tree = await response.json();
const container = document.getElementById('fileTree');
container.innerHTML = '';
renderTree(tree, container);
}

function renderTree(items, container, level = 0) {
items.forEach(item => {
const div = document.createElement('div');
div.className = item.type === 'directory' ? 'tree-item tree-item-folder' : 'tree-item tree-item-file';
div.style.paddingLeft = (level * 15 + 10) + 'px';
div.textContent = item.name;
if (item.type === 'file') {
div.onclick = () => openFile(item.path);
}
container.appendChild(div);
if (item.children) {
renderTree(item.children, container, level + 1);
}
});
}

async function openFile(path) {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const data = await response.json();
currentFile = path;
if (editor) {
editor.setValue(data.content);
const ext = path.split('.').pop();
const langMap = {js: 'javascript', py: 'python', html: 'html', css: 'css', json: 'json', md: 'markdown', ts: 'typescript', jsx: 'javascript', tsx: 'typescript'};
monaco.editor.setModelLanguage(editor.getModel(), langMap[ext] || 'plaintext');
}
openTabs[path] = data.content;
updateTabs();
}

function updateTabs() {
const container = document.getElementById('editorTabs');
container.innerHTML = '';
Object.keys(openTabs).forEach(path => {
const tab = document.createElement('div');
tab.className = 'tab' + (path === currentFile ? ' active' : '');
tab.textContent = path.split('/').pop();
tab.onclick = () => openFile(path);
container.appendChild(tab);
});
}

async function saveCurrentFile() {
if (!currentFile || !editor) return;
const content = editor.getValue();
await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(currentFile)}`, {
method: 'PUT',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({path: currentFile, content})
});
alert('File saved');
}

function connectTerminal() {
if (terminalSocket) {
terminalSocket.close();
}
terminalSocket = new WebSocket(`ws://${location.host}/ws/terminal/${currentProject}`);
terminalSocket.onopen = () => {
terminal.onData(data => {
terminalSocket.send(data);
});
};
terminalSocket.onmessage = (event) => {
if (event.data instanceof Blob) {
event.data.arrayBuffer().then(buffer => {
terminal.write(new Uint8Array(buffer));
});
} else {
terminal.write(event.data);
}
};
}

function switchPanel(panel) {
document.querySelectorAll('.panel-tab').forEach(tab => tab.classList.remove('active'));
event.target.classList.add('active');
document.querySelectorAll('.panel-content > div').forEach(div => div.classList.add('hide'));
document.getElementById(panel + 'Panel').classList.remove('hide');
}

async function loadWorkflows() {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/workflows`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const workflows = await response.json();
const list = document.getElementById('workflowsList');
list.innerHTML = '';
workflows.forEach(workflow => {
const item = document.createElement('div');
item.className = 'workflow-item';
item.innerHTML = `<span>${workflow.name}</span><button class="workflow-btn" onclick="runWorkflow('${workflow.name}')">Run</button>`;
list.appendChild(item);
});
}

async function runWorkflow(name) {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/workflows/run`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({name})
});
const data = await response.json();
pollRunStatus(data.run_id);
}

async function pollRunStatus(runId) {
const interval = setInterval(async () => {
const response = await fetch(`/api/runs/${runId}`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const run = await response.json();
document.getElementById('logOutput').textContent = run.log;
if (run.status !== 'running') {
clearInterval(interval);
}
}, 1000);
}

async function loadCheckpoints() {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/checkpoints`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const checkpoints = await response.json();
const list = document.getElementById('checkpointsList');
list.innerHTML = '';
checkpoints.forEach(checkpoint => {
const item = document.createElement('div');
item.className = 'checkpoint-item';
item.innerHTML = `<span>${checkpoint.label} (${checkpoint.git_commit.substring(0, 7)})</span><button class="workflow-btn" onclick="rollback('${checkpoint.id}')">Rollback</button>`;
list.appendChild(item);
});
}

async function createCheckpoint() {
const label = prompt('Checkpoint label:');
if (!label) return;
await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/checkpoints`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({label})
});
await loadCheckpoints();
}

async function rollback(checkpointId) {
if (!confirm('Rollback to this checkpoint?')) return;
await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/rollback`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({checkpoint_id: checkpointId})
});
await loadFileTree();
}

async function loadSecrets() {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/secrets`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const secrets = await response.json();
const list = document.getElementById('secretsList');
list.innerHTML = '';
secrets.forEach(key => {
const item = document.createElement('div');
item.className = 'secret-item';
item.innerHTML = `<span>${key}</span><button class="workflow-btn" onclick="deleteSecret('${key}')">Delete</button>`;
list.appendChild(item);
});
}

async function addSecret() {
const key = document.getElementById('secretKey').value;
const value = document.getElementById('secretValue').value;
await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/secrets/${key}`, {
method: 'PUT',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({value})
});
closeModal('addSecretModal');
await loadSecrets();
}

async function deleteSecret(key) {
if (!confirm('Delete secret?')) return;
await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/secrets/${key}`, {
method: 'DELETE',
headers: getAuthHeaders()
});
await loadSecrets();
}

async function loadDeployments() {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/deployments`, {headers: getAuthHeaders()});
const deployments = await response.json();
const list = document.getElementById('deploymentsList');
list.innerHTML = '';
deployments.forEach(deployment => {
const item = document.createElement('div');
item.className = 'deployment-item';
item.innerHTML = `<div>${deployment.type} - ${deployment.status}</div>${deployment.url ? `<div>${deployment.url}</div>` : ''}`;
list.appendChild(item);
});
}

async function createDeployment() {
const type = document.getElementById('deploymentType').value;
await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/deployments`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({type, config: {}})
});
closeModal('newDeploymentModal');
await loadDeployments();
}

async function createAgentSession() {
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/agent/sessions`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({goal: 'Help with development'})
});
const data = await response.json();
agentSessionId = data.id;
}

async function sendAgentMessage() {
const input = document.getElementById('agentInput');
const message = input.value;
if (!message) return;
input.value = '';
const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
msgDiv.className = 'agent-message';
msgDiv.textContent = `You: ${message}`;
document.getElementById('agentMessages').appendChild(msgDiv);
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/agent/sessions/${agentSessionId}/message`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({message})
});
const data = await response.json();
const responseDiv = document.createElement('div');
responseDiv.className = 'agent-message';
responseDiv.textContent = `Agent: ${JSON.stringify(data.response)}`;
document.getElementById('agentMessages').appendChild(responseDiv);
document.getElementById('agentMessages').scrollTop = document.getElementById('agentMessages').scrollHeight;
}

function showNewProjectModal() {
document.getElementById('newProjectModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function showImportGitModal() {
document.getElementById('importGitModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function showSearchModal() {
document.getElementById('searchModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function showAddSecretModal() {
document.getElementById('addSecretModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function showNewDeploymentModal() {
document.getElementById('newDeploymentModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function closeModal(modalId) {
document.getElementById(modalId).style.display = 'none';
}

async function createProject() {
const name = document.getElementById('newProjectName').value;
await fetch('/api/projects', {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({name})
});
closeModal('newProjectModal');
await loadProjects();
}

async function importGit() {
const gitUrl = document.getElementById('gitUrl').value;
const name = document.getElementById('gitProjectName').value;
await fetch('/api/projects/import/git', {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({git_url: gitUrl, name})
});
closeModal('importGitModal');
await loadProjects();
}

async function performSearch() {
const query = document.getElementById('searchQuery').value;
const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${currentProject}/search`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: {...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: JSON.stringify({query})
});
const results = await response.json();
const container = document.getElementById('searchResults');
container.innerHTML = '';
results.forEach(result => {
const div = document.createElement('div');
div.style.marginBottom = '10px';
div.innerHTML = `<strong>${result.path}</strong>`;
result.matches.forEach(match => {
const matchDiv = document.createElement('div');
matchDiv.textContent = `Line ${match.line}: ${match.text}`;
matchDiv.style.paddingLeft = '20px';
div.appendChild(matchDiv);
});
container.appendChild(div);
});
}

if (localStorage.getItem('token')) {
document.getElementById('loginContainer').style.display = 'none';
document.getElementById('ideContainer').style.display = 'flex';
initIDE();
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
